# sprint issues comments reply

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

[CLI index](../../../README.md) · [Parent](../comments.md)

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint issues comments reply — Reply in the same authorized issue thread. Visibility internal|synced is fixed at creation; mentionMemberIds are exact authorized IDs.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint issues comments reply ISSUE_ID --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH --operation-key KEY [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Reply in the same authorized issue thread. Visibility internal|synced is fixed at creation; mentionMemberIds are exact authorized IDs.

EXAMPLES
  sprint issues comments reply ISSUE_ID --file input.json --operation-key KEY

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  ISSUE_ID

FLAGS
  --operation-key KEY (required; see SYNOPSIS)
  --non-interactive
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output {data} on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  JSON payload: {"parentId":"Required same-issue parent ID","body":"Required reply text","mentionMemberIds":"Optional authorized member IDs","visibility":"internal | synced"}

SEE ALSO
  sprint help issues comments
  sprint topic output
  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/blob/main/cli/reference/issues/comments/reply.md
```
